title: Mr. X's work on exotic vacuum objects and self-organizing plasma
summary: Jay Anderson tells of Mr. X's work on exotic vacuum objects and self-organizing plasma, about about 2020-2021 at unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And Mr. X, who just doesn't want to be named, he's not a government guy. He's just he's a savant. He's really is a savant. Um, he did so much work on EVOs, exotic vacuum objects, and this like self-organizing plasma.

plain: Jay Anderson, a guest on Jesse Michels' podcast, talks about a man he will only call Mr. X, who he says is not a government man but a true savant. Anderson says that around 2020 and 2021 Mr. X did a great deal of work on what are called exotic vacuum objects, or EVOs, and on self-organizing plasma, meaning electrically charged gas that arranges itself into shapes. If true, it would mean a private outsider had made real progress on strange forms of energy.
